title: stayneria neilii
intro: Stayneria neilii, commonly known as the "New Caledonian tree", is a species of flowering plant in the family Staphylocarpaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Stayneria neilii include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce the risk of infections. The bioactive constituents of Stayneria neilii include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
